svg.title: Freshworks: the operating-profit bridge for the June quarter
svg.desc: Q2 2026 versus Q2 2025, USD millions, whole company. Additional revenue 32.699 less additional cost of revenue 4.954 and operating expenses 13.029 leaves a 14.716 improvement in operating income. The 11.432 stock-compensation decline is already within costs. This is accrual profit, not collected cash or an AI-only margin.
